passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 04
passage.text:
TEXT A - Birthday Invitation

YOU'RE INVITED!

I'm thrilled to invite you to my 30th birthday! The venue has a spectacular city view. Please RSVP so I can confirm the headcount. If you feel inclined to bring something, I'm collecting donations for the animal shelter.

TEXT B - Health Advisory

Flu Season Alert

The health department recommends precautionary measures during flu season. Vaccination is advisable for vulnerable groups. Maintain adequate hygiene by washing hands frequently. These simple steps can significantly reduce infection risk.

TEXT C - Product Recall Notice

URGENT: Product Recall

We are issuing a voluntary recall of batch #XYZ123. A manufacturing defect was detected during quality control. Customers should discontinue use immediately. Full refunds are available at all retail locations.
